Provenance (moved from guide body):
This guide was induced **purely from a set of expert (SME) review feedback** on machine
translations of SNOMED CT terms (imaging, interventional and nuclear-medicine procedures).
Every rule below is a generalisation of a recurring correction or approval the reviewer
applied; none is a memorised term-by-term answer. Apply the rules to unseen terms — do not
treat any single Korean string here as a canonical output for a specific source term.
